publication.title: Grounding Multimodal Large Language Model in GUI World

name: Grounding Multimodal Large Language Model in GUI World
notes: Reviewed against the ICLR 2025 proceedings page and PDF; the OpenReview forum lists it as an ICLR 2025 Poster. The grounding model, AssistGUIGrounder (AGG), pairs a SAM-pretrained ViT image encoder and a transformer query encoder with a two-layer box decoder. The data engine loads Common Crawl pages from 118 domains in a browser such as Chrome, scrolls them with Page Down and reads element data through UI Automation; grounding training used 0.36M web images with 22M annotations after smoothing, plus 27K mobile screenshots from WidgetCaption and RICO. ScreenSpot grounding covers mobile, desktop and web screenshots; agent fine-tuning covers MiniWob, AITW and Mind2Web. The paper gives github.com/showlab/AssistGUIGround for code and data; that repository returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-19. No arXiv version was found.
summary: Trains a 0.4B SAM-initialized GUI grounding model on 0.5M auto-collected web screenshots with 35M element annotations, then links it to a Qwen-VL planner through a position token for MiniWob, AITW and Mind2Web.
